why: In bet-hedging theory variance is ADAPTIVE - it pays off in a FLUCTUATING environment via geometric-mean fitness. drmSEM is cross-sectional and cannot represent that literature. The README variance example has a constant environment where variance is purely a cost, so the label predicts the OPPOSITE of what the figure shows. Say "cost of variance under diminishing returns" instead.

Technically means WITHIN-individual asymmetry (fluctuating asymmetry), measured on bilateral traits. A single measurement per individual supports only "among-individual heterogeneity" - a related but distinct claim. A specialist reviewer will flag the misuse.
